    highlight: tango
    toc: true
    toc_float:
      collapsed: false
      smooth_scroll: true
    number_sections: false
params:
  wb_path: "."
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# ── Packages ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
required <- c("rdflib", "dplyr", "stringr", "lubridate",
              "timevis", "DT", "knitr", "kableExtra", "htmltools")

missing_pkgs <- required[!required %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  stop("Missing packages: ", paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "))
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(rdflib)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(lubridate)
  library(timevis)
  library(DT)
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
  library(htmltools)
})

# ── Paths ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
wb_path    <- normalizePath(params$wb_path, mustWork = TRUE)
wb_name    <- basename(wb_path)
ttl_path   <- file.path(wb_path, "workbench.ttl")
tasks_path <- file.path(wb_path, "tasks.ttl")
readme_path <- file.path(wb_path, "README.md")

# ── Constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
STATUS_LEVELS <- c("Active", "Blocked", "OnHold", "Planned", "Completed")

STATUS_COLORS <- c(
  Active    = "#27AE60",
  Blocked   = "#E74C3C",
  OnHold    = "#E67E22",
  Planned   = "#2980B9",
  Completed = "#95A5A6"
)

STATUS_PRIORITY <- c(Active = 1L, Blocked = 2L, OnHold = 3L,
                     Planned = 4L, Completed = 5L)

# ── SPARQL: workbench metadata ────────────────────────────────────────────────
SPARQL_META <- "
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX schema:  <https://schema.org/>
PREFIX skos:    <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>

SELECT ?title ?description ?created ?author
WHERE {
  ?wb a skos:ConceptScheme ;
      dcterms:title ?title .
  OPTIONAL { ?wb dcterms:description ?description }
  OPTIONAL { ?wb dcterms:created     ?created     }
  OPTIONAL { ?wb schema:author       ?author      }
}
LIMIT 1
"

# ── SPARQL: tasks ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
SPARQL_TASKS <- "
PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/>
PREFIX rdfs:   <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX wbs:    <http://example.org/workbench/status#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?name ?statusLabel ?startDate ?targetDate ?priority ?note
WHERE {
  ?task a schema:Action ;
        schema:name         ?name ;
        schema:actionStatus ?status .
  ?status rdfs:label ?statusLabel .
  OPTIONAL { ?task schema:startDate     ?startDate  }
  OPTIONAL { ?task schema:scheduledTime ?targetDate }
  OPTIONAL { ?task schema:priority      ?priority   }
  OPTIONAL { ?task rdfs:comment         ?note       }
}
ORDER BY ?statusLabel ?name
"

# ── Load workbench metadata ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
wb_meta <- list(
  title       = str_remove(wb_name, "^wb-\\d{4}-\\d{2}-") |> str_replace_all("-", " ") |> str_to_title(),
  description = "",
  created     = "",
  author      = ""
)

if (file.exists(ttl_path)) {
  tryCatch({
    rdf_obj   <- rdf_parse(ttl_path, format = "turtle")
    meta_rows <- rdf_query(rdf_obj, SPARQL_META)
    tryCatch(rdf_free(rdf_obj), error = function(e) NULL)

    if (nrow(meta_rows) > 0) {
      wb_meta$title       <- coalesce(meta_rows$title[1],       wb_meta$title)
      wb_meta$description <- coalesce(meta_rows$description[1], "")
      wb_meta$created     <- coalesce(meta_rows$created[1],     "")
      wb_meta$author      <- coalesce(meta_rows$author[1],      "")
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Could not parse workbench.ttl: ", conditionMessage(e))
  })
}

# ── Load tasks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tasks_raw <- NULL

if (file.exists(tasks_path)) {
  tryCatch({
    rdf_obj   <- rdf_parse(tasks_path, format = "turtle")
    tasks_raw <- rdf_query(rdf_obj, SPARQL_TASKS)
    tryCatch(rdf_free(rdf_obj), error = function(e) NULL)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Could not parse tasks.ttl: ", conditionMessage(e))
  })
}

# ── Clean tasks ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
today <- Sys.Date()
tasks <- NULL

if (!is.null(tasks_raw) && nrow(tasks_raw) > 0) {
  tasks <- tasks_raw |>
    mutate(
      status      = factor(statusLabel, levels = STATUS_LEVELS),
      start_date  = if_else(!is.na(startDate),  ymd(startDate),  today),
      open_ended  = is.na(targetDate),
      target_date = if_else(!is.na(targetDate), ymd(targetDate), start_date + 30L),
      status_rank = STATUS_PRIORITY[as.character(status)],
      color       = STATUS_COLORS[as.character(status)]
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(status)) |>
    arrange(status_rank, start_date)
}

has_tasks <- !is.null(tasks) && nrow(tasks) > 0
```

```{css}
/* ── Global ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
body { font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; }

/* ── Workbench header ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.wb-header {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2C3E50 0%, #3D5168 100%);
  color: white;
  padding: 28px 32px 22px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
}
.wb-header h1 {
  margin: 0 0 6px 0;
  font-size: 1.8em;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: white;
  border: none;
}
.wb-header .wb-description {

  margin: 0 0 12px 0;
}

/* ── Status badges ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.badge-status {

  font-size: 0.78em;

}

/* ── Status summary table ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.status-summary {
  display: flex;
  gap: 14px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin: 18px 0 24px;
}
.status-card {
  flex: 1 1 120px;
  padding: 14px 18px;

}
.status-card .count  { font-size: 2em; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; }
.status-card .label  { font-size: 0.8em; opacity: 0.88; margin-top: 4px; }

/* ── README section ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.readme-content {
  background: #FAFBFC;
  border-left: 4px solid #3D5168;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;

}
.readme-content h2 { font-size: 1.15em; color: #2C3E50; margin-top: 20px; }
.readme-content h2:first-child { margin-top: 0; }

/* ── Section headers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
h2 { color: #2C3E50; border-bottom: 2px solid #ECF0F1; padding-bottom: 6px; }
h3 { color: #3D5168; }

/* ── Footer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.report-footer {
  margin-top: 40px;
  padding-top: 14px;
  border-top: 1px solid #ECF0F1;
  font-size: 0.8em;
  color: #95A5A6;
  text-align: center;
}
```

```{r wb-header, results='asis'}
# Workbench header block
meta_parts <- character(0)
if (nchar(wb_meta$created)  > 0) meta_parts <- c(meta_parts, paste0("Started: ", wb_meta$created))
if (nchar(wb_meta$author)   > 0) meta_parts <- c(meta_parts, paste0("Author: ",  wb_meta$author))
meta_parts <- c(meta_parts, paste0("Workbench: ", wb_name))

cat(paste0('
<div class="wb-header">
  <h1>', wb_meta$title, '</h1>',
  if (nchar(wb_meta$description) > 0)
    paste0('<p class="wb-description">', wb_meta$description, '</p>')
  else "",
  '<div class="wb-meta">',
  paste(paste0("<span>", meta_parts, "</span>"), collapse = ""),
  '</div>
</div>
'))
```

---

## Overview

```{r readme, results='asis'}
if (file.exists(readme_path)) {
  readme_lines <- readLines(readme_path, warn = FALSE)

  # Strip the first # heading (title already shown in header)
  first_h1 <- which(str_detect(readme_lines, "^#\\s"))[1]
  if (!is.na(first_h1)) readme_lines <- readme_lines[-first_h1]

  cat('<div class="readme-content">\n\n')
  cat(paste(readme_lines, collapse = "\n"))
  cat('\n\n</div>\n')
} else {
  cat('*No README.md found in this workbench.*\n')
}
```

---

## Task Status

```{r status-summary, results='asis'}
if (has_tasks) {
  status_counts <- tasks |>
    count(statusLabel) |>
    mutate(status = factor(statusLabel, levels = STATUS_LEVELS)) |>
    arrange(status) |>
    right_join(data.frame(statusLabel = STATUS_LEVELS), by = "statusLabel") |>
    mutate(n = coalesce(n, 0L))

  cards <- paste(
    apply(status_counts, 1, function(row) {
      label  <- row[["statusLabel"]]
      count  <- row[["n"]]
      color  <- STATUS_COLORS[[label]]
      paste0(
        '<div class="status-card" style="background:', color, '">',
        '<div class="count">', count, '</div>',
        '<div class="label">',  label, '</div>',
        '</div>'
      )
    }),
    collapse = "\n"
  )

  cat('<div class="status-summary">\n', cards, '\n</div>\n')

  # Open-ended note
  n_open <- sum(tasks$open_ended)
  if (n_open > 0) {
    cat(paste0(
      '<p class="note-open-ended">⚠ ',
      n_open, ' task', if (n_open > 1) "s" else "",
      ' without a target date (shown as +30d estimate in timeline).</p>\n'
    ))
  }
} else {
  cat('*No tasks found in tasks.ttl.*\n')
}
```

## Timeline

```{r timeline, results='asis'}
if (!has_tasks) {
  cat("*No tasks to display.*\n")
} else {
  cat('<div class="timeline-container">\n')
}
```

```{r timevis, eval=has_tasks}
tv_data <- tasks |>
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) |>
  transmute(
    id      = row_id,
    content = str_wrap(name, width = 30) |> str_replace_all("\n", "<br/>"),
    start   = as.character(start_date),
    end     = as.character(target_date),
    title   = paste0(
      "<div style='padding:8px;font-size:12px;min-width:200px'>",
      "<b>", name, "</b><br/>",
      "<span style='color:", STATUS_COLORS[statusLabel], "'>● </span>",
      statusLabel,
      if_else(!is.na(priority),
              paste0("  ·  Priority: <b>", priority, "</b>"), ""),
      if_else(open_ended,
              "  ·  <i>no target date</i>", ""),
      if_else(!is.na(note),
              paste0("<br/><br/><i>", note, "</i>"), ""),
      "</div>"
    ),
    style   = paste0(
      "background-color:", STATUS_COLORS[statusLabel], ";",
      "border-color:",     STATUS_COLORS[statusLabel], ";",
      "color:white; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px;",
      if_else(open_ended, "opacity:0.6; border-style:dashed;", "")
    )
  )

timevis(
  data    = tv_data,
  options = list(
    start           = as.character(today - 14L),
    end             = as.character(today + 120L),
    editable        = FALSE,
    stack           = TRUE,
    showMajorLabels = TRUE,
    zoomMin         = 604800000L,   # 1 week
    height          = "280px"
  )
)
```

```{r timeline-close, results='asis'}
if (has_tasks) cat("</div>\n")
```

---

## All Tasks

```{r task-table, eval=has_tasks}
dt_data <- tasks |>
  transmute(
    Task     = name,
    Status   = statusLabel,
    Priority = coalesce(priority, "—"),
    Start    = as.character(start_date),
    Target   = if_else(open_ended,
                       paste0(as.character(target_date), " †"),
                       as.character(target_date)),
    Notes    = coalesce(note, "")
  )

# Build status color lookup for JS callback
status_js_colors <- paste(
  paste0('"', names(STATUS_COLORS), '":"', STATUS_COLORS, '"'),
  collapse = ","
)

datatable(
  dt_data,
  rownames  = FALSE,
  escape    = FALSE,
  filter    = "top",
  extensions = "Buttons",
  options   = list(
    pageLength = 25,
    dom        = "Bfrtip",
    buttons    = list("csv", "excel"),
    order      = list(list(1L, "asc"), list(3L, "asc")),
    columnDefs = list(
      list(width = "35%", targets = 0L),
      list(width = "10%", targets = c(1L, 2L, 3L, 4L)),
      list(width = "25%", targets = 5L)
    )
  ),
  callback = JS(paste0("
    var colors = {", status_js_colors, "};
    table.column(1).nodes().each(function(cell, i) {
      var status = $(cell).text().trim();
      if (colors[status]) {
        $(cell).html(
          '<span class=\"badge-status badge-' + status + '\">' + status + '</span>'
        );
      }
    });
  "))
)
```
